availability_quote_required: current written quote for dedicated RTX 6000 Ada 48-GB ECC, non-vGPU, active-cooled server placement
CUDA compute capability 8.9 and driver compatibility with the exact pinned image are stated or execution-probed
12-24 month committed, non-preemptible terms at 8-64 GPU scale with region, topology and included services
one self-service or provider-confirmed experimental allocation is obtainable within the prospective budget
activation_trigger.false_branch: If either the L40S scientific terminal or availability/quote gate fails, expire this arm with no provider create.
l40s_required: actual NCCL/CUDA TP=PP=DP=1 identity and teardown pass
sentinel plus all six c12 M=12 and M=3679 rows have finite positive CUDA/wall distributions and output-consuming BF16 oracles
actual peak reserve leaves >=0.25 GiB in the 44.704-GiB envelope
request-weighted component total is below 1.229949102 seconds/request
activation_trigger.name: VALID_L40S_FP8_C12_TERMINAL_AND_MATCHED_QUOTE

nominee.compatibility: same SM89 profile, 142 SMs, 96-MB L2, CUDA stack and native FP8 as L40S; this is source/architecture admission only and fresh exact-image execution remains mandatory

rejected.reason: shared inventory binds SM86 and no native FP8; it is not content-bound compatible with the exact SM89 online-FP8 consumer/kernel lane

capacity_gate.decision: c12 passes the logical gate with 0.827762 GiB peak-context headroom; c14 fails the 0.25-GiB rule and is excluded
capacity_gate.runtime_rule: candidate peak_reserved_gib plus 0.25 must be <=44.704; logical accounting cannot substitute for measured allocator telemetry

versus_l40s_at_quote_cap.transfer_prohibited: These ratios are decision thresholds only. No L40S component or endpoint throughput is assigned to RTX 6000 Ada.

evidence_scope: content-bound shared inventory/pricing plus derived arithmetic; no provider query, GPU, image, checkpoint, compilation, live-owner observation, or throughput transfer

matched_arm.comparator: fresh L40S rerun and RTX 6000 Ada candidate using identical pinned image, immutable staged bytes, single-rank NCCL context, warmup/repetition/order, and exact shapes; do not compare against historical timing rows alone
decision_rules: Any kernel/runtime/oracle/allocator mismatch closes compatibility without a throughput inference.
Report candidate/comparator component-time ratios directly; at a 0.77 quote, >1.428571x is worse than L40S equal-cost parity and >1.285714x misses the 10%-better sensitivity.
A component pass cannot claim the strict 0.501943 completed-rps endpoint gate; it only admits one later complete-request test with hardware-specific residuals.
program: sentinel actual Fp8OnlineLinearMethod process/apply for sliding QKV 5376->16384 at M=12
all six exact linears at decode M=12 and fresh-prompt M=3679 with matched actual BF16 output-consuming oracle
actual BF16 ParallelLMHead and actual FP8 KV writer under the same accounting used by the L40S terminal

prospective_budget.compute: 0.30 RTX 6000 Ada GPU-hours plus 1 local CPU-hour
prospective_budget.lifecycle: one allocation, one matched primary, no paid repair; authenticated zero-resource cleanup
prospective_budget.storage: one 100-GiB boot disk; 512 MiB retained plus 2 GiB temporary artifacts

matched_arm.question: Does the exact online-FP8 c12 component retain enough performance on RTX 6000 Ada to justify a later complete-request endpoint at its written committed rate?
required_measurements: per-shape raw CUDA-event and wall distributions, medians, p95, CV and arm order
finite/nontrivial output oracle and exact selected kernel symbols/source hashes
kernel grid/block, registers/thread, static/dynamic shared memory and achieved occupancy
peak allocated/reserved, KV/workspace bytes and the >=0.25-GiB c12 reserve check
SM/memory clocks, power, temperature and thermal/power throttle reasons
provider meter, failures/reloads and authenticated cleanup inventory

uncertainty: The shared price inventory has no RTX 6000 Ada committed planning join; the 0.77 rate is a same-day public on-demand prior, not a production rate.
Same SM89 architecture strongly narrows compatibility risk but does not establish exact-image execution, sustained clocks, thermal behavior, or throughput.
Component ratios do not transfer to whole-request throughput; a matched endpoint is still required after a component pass.
